system.description:
Allows the imbiber to levitate himself, moving vertically up or down, but provides no assistance with lateral movement. A wall, cliff side, or ceiling could be used to move along hand-over-hand. Levitation allows up or downward movement at a rate of up to 6 feet per minute (60 feet per turn), and the user cannot levitate more than 20 feet per level from the ground level where the effect began (such range being applied both to movement into the air and to downward movement into a pit or chasm).

Duration: 1d6+1 turns.
system.effect: Levitate vertically up or down at 6' per minute
